name: Gifts of the Gods of Egypt

pages.text: Khopesh of the pharaoh: damage 8.5, attack speed 1.6, durability 1650, fireproof. Every blow withers the foe for 3 seconds.

Was-sceptre: durability 250. Right-click raises a storm: the foes within 8 blocks are thrown back, blinded and slowed. Every 10 seconds.$(br)Nemes of the Sphinx: armour 3, toughness 2, durability 330. Night Vision.
Pectoral of Ra: armour 8, toughness 2.5, knockback -5%, durability 528, fireproof. Fire Resistance and Strength.
Elytra and the wings of Daedalus can go in the back slot (right of the player in the inventory) together with a chestplate: they fly and work just the same.
